Info.location: function radarValue = radarSimulation(scenario, probe) %% ============================================================ % Function Name : radarSimulation % % Description : % محاكاة استجابة رادار UWB للكشف عن الضحية. % يعتمد النموذج على: % - Vital Signs Strength % - Attenuation % - Burial Depth % - Environmental Noise %% ============================================================ r = probe.position(1); c = probe.position(2); A = scenario.environment.attenuation(r,c); B = scenario.environment.burialDepth(r,c); N = scenario.environment.noise(r,c); V = scenario.environment.vitalSigns(r,c); radarValue = ... V .* exp(-2*A) .* ... exp(-1.5*B) .* ... (1-N); radarValue = max(0,min(1,radarValue)); end.m
